ambient_openings.description: Open weather deck exchange with ambient (CONTAM-AMBIENT-WEATHER-AMPHIBIOUS-01). area_m2 is ASSUMED-OPEN-DECK-FACE-AREA, Grade C: no drawing gives the deck edge, so it is the two opposite side faces of a square-plan deck of this zone's volume at the exporter's 3 m zone height, 2 * sqrt(V / 3) * 3. wind_speed_m_s is the declared relative-wind axis [0, 10] m/s at its committed point 1 m/s (the exporter's wind-pressure-test speed), Grade C, not a measured wind. exchange_m3h is the ContamX-solved outward flow through the opening at that point, commissioned lane (D5).
